articles.title: India set for $2-billion drone order in biggest buy, industry body says
articles.summary: India is set to make its largest military drone purchase, ordering over $2 billion worth from domestic firms this year. This significant acquisition underscores India's commitment to modernising its armed forces with advanced unmanned aerial systems and boosting indigenous defence manufacturing under the 'Make in India' initiative, enhancing self-reliance and operational capabilities.

articles.title: Indian Army 144 TGC Technical Graduate Engineer Jan 2027 Course
articles.summary: The Indian Army is inviting online applications from unmarried Male Engineering Graduates for the 144th Technical Graduate Course (TGC). This prestigious officer entry scheme is set to commence in January 2027. Aspirants with engineering degrees looking for a career in defence should review the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria and application deadlines to secure their opportunity.

articles.title: 22k gold rate today: Check 24k, 22k, 18k gold prices (June 3, 2026) at Tanishq, Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers, Malabar Gold & Diamonds and IBJA
articles.summary: Despite persistent international market uncertainties continuing to shape gold investor sentiment, prices for the precious metal at major jewellery chains experienced little change today. This stability in domestic gold rates suggests a potential resilience amidst global economic fluctuations, highlighting a nuanced market response as investors weigh international developments against local demand and supply dynamics.

articles.title: Iran attacks Kuwait's international airport and fires missiles at Bahrain while US strikes island in Strait of Hormuz as Trump tries to forge peace deal
articles.summary: Fresh hostilities flared in the Gulf, with Iranian drones damaging Kuwait's airport and missiles targeting Bahrain. The escalating conflict saw the US respond with strikes on Iran's Qeshm. This incident underscores the volatile regional security environment and complex geopolitical dynamics in the Middle East, vital for understanding global defence challenges.

articles.title: Iranian drone attack hits Kuwait airport, causing injuries
articles.summary: Kuwait suspended commercial flights following an Iranian drone attack that heavily damaged its airport and caused injuries. This incident occurred hours after Iran and the United States traded missile strikes, indicating a significant escalation of regional tensions. The situation underscores the volatile security environment in the Middle East, with potential broader implications for international stability and trade.

articles.title: ‘No better day than this’: Army pilot proposes to girlfriend right after passing-out parade, proposal goes viral
articles.summary: An Indian Army pilot gained widespread attention for proposing to his girlfriend right after his passing-out parade. The viral proposal, hailed as a perfectly timed romantic gesture, highlights the personal milestones and human stories within the disciplined life of defence personnel. It showcases a blend of commitment to service and personal joy, resonating as a touching moment for the armed forces community.

articles.title: T-Hub launches third space-tech startup cohort
articles.summary: Startup incubator T-Hub has launched the third cohort of its ORBIT SpaceTech accelerator programme, an initiative under the Atal Incubation Centre. This cohort includes 13 innovative startups focused on developing cutting-edge space technologies. The program aims to foster indigenous innovation and bolster India's growing space sector, contributing significantly to national technological advancement and self-reliance in this strategic domain.

articles.title: How one optimal AUKUS submarine pathway became two
articles.summary: The defence sector often uses highly technical and convoluted language, making its mission seem more complex than it is. Terms like 'platforms' for ships and planes are common jargon. This linguistic opacity can hinder clear communication and understanding, potentially impacting public perception and internal efficiency – a crucial aspect for aspiring officers to comprehend and navigate effectively.

articles.title: Drone strike kills 7 on bus in Russia-held eastern Ukraine: authorities
articles.summary: Kiev experienced renewed drone and missile attacks on June 2, 2026, amidst the ongoing Russian invasion of Ukraine. One particularly devastating drone strike tragically resulted in the deaths of seven people, causing significant fires and widespread destruction. These assaults underscore the persistent human cost and escalating military actions in the protracted conflict.
